name: Jumper
description: Commit, push and pull your KiCad project to Jumper, open pull requests and see check results from the PCB editor.
description_full:
Jumper hosts KiCad projects with visual diffs, design review and automatic ERC/DRC, BOM and fabrication outputs on every push.

This plugin adds a Jumper button to the PCB editor's top toolbar (and Tools > External Plugins > Jumper). It shows what changed, commits it with a message, pushes it to Jumper, pulls your team's changes, starts a branch and opens a pull request, and shows the ERC/DRC check results for your latest push. It only fast-forwards: if your copy and the server both changed, it tells you instead of merging behind your back.

Requires git on your PATH. Works with HTTPS (using a personal access token) and SSH remotes.
